_about: Curated ADD-only log of AI-lab deals (compute, chips, leases, power, financing tied to a deployment). One row per deal fact. Never edit or delete a row; add a new row when a deal is updated. Fields: date = date of the cited source document (call or filing date, YYYY-MM-DD), not necessarily the signing date; lab = lab id as used in graph/ai_labs.json (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, Mistral AI, ...); counterparty = the other side; what = one English sentence with the concrete terms; gw = gigawatts (number or null); value_usd = dollar value (number or null); source = source name; url = the public link of the source (the SEC filing, or the company's investor-relations events page for a call), shown on nodus42.com; url_or_path = the same public URL or the Nodus42 transcript path (transcripts/...) where each quote can be found; quotes = verbatim sentence(s) from that source (grep -F must find each one); added / added_by = when and by whom the row was appended. The nightly enrich session appends rows from news. market/ai_labs.py reads this file and never writes it.

quotes: Anthropic will deploy up to 2 GW of MI450 series GPUs in Helios, with deployment of the first gigawatt beginning in the first half of 2027.

rows.what: Product purchase agreement (October 2025) to deploy 6 GW of AMD GPUs, the first gigawatt on Instinct MI450; AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01
quotes: In October 2025, we entered into a product purchase agreement with OpenAI OpCo, LLC, (OpenAI) to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, with the deployment of the first gigawatt of capacity powered by our AMD Instinct MI450 series products.
Concurrent with the agreement, we issued to OpenAI a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 160 million shares of AMD’s common stock at an exercise price of $0.01 per share.

rows.what: NVIDIA guarantees (August 2026) for SB Energy's PORTS campus in Pike County, Ohio: about 4.25 GW of IT load hosting NVIDIA compute under 20-year leases to OpenAI; NVIDIA's obligation capped at $105B
quotes: In August 2026, we entered into guarantees with SB Energy Corp. to provide credit support on the land, power, and shell buildout at SB Energy’s PORTS Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, covering leases for approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load.

The campus will exclusively host our compute under 20-year leases to OpenAI, subject to limited exceptions, with our obligation capped at $105 billion in the aggregate, subject to certain conditions including SB Energy, the lessor, satisfying applicable ready-for-service conditions.

rows.what: $11.6B multi-year agreement for Akamai Cloud distributed infrastructure (CPU workloads); possible expansion by up to $9B more (about $20B total); Akamai issued Anthropic a warrant for up to about 5% of its stock
quotes: Akamai Announces $11.6 Billion Multi-year Agreement with Anthropic to Support Growing Demand
The transaction provides for the potential expansion of the relationship by up to an additional $9 billion, which represents a total potential commitment of approximately $20 billion
Akamai has issued a warrant to Anthropic, the continued vesting of which is tied to the successful expansion of the relationship, for up to approximately 5% of Akamai’s common stock outstanding.
